'''Plako''' was a [[Chikarri]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] who knew the location of the legendary [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Fool's Gold]]''. [[Bruce Mercy]] and his [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] band attempted to steal this information.
